claim_summary: GridMind contributes feedback-driven multi-agent orchestration for ACOPF and contingency analysis, but the implemented work focuses on power-system network cases rather than time-series tasks.

claim_evidence.quote: The GridMind prototype focuses on two power system applications, ACOPF and CA, coordinated through an agentic workflow.

task_performance.quote: The left figure shows that all tested models achieve 100% success rates across IEEE test case118, demonstrating that function-calling capabilities enable reliable technical accuracy regardless of the underlying LLM.

notes: Although the introduction mentions forecasting as one of many power-system analysis domains, the implemented agents and reported experiments cover ACOPF and T-1 contingency analysis on IEEE network cases; the packet does not show ordered numerical time-series data as a primary input or output.
